experimental_unit: one (trace_family, capacity) instance -- NOT individual requests. 7 traces x 3 capacities = 21 paired instances per policy comparison. Requests within one trace-capacity replay are sequentially dependent (cache state carries forward), not independent replicates, and are never treated as such.
comparison_design: paired: every policy is scored on the identical 21 (trace, capacity) instances under the identical primary_controlled_window protocol, so differences are computed per-instance, not from independently-sampled runs.
reported_statistics: per_instance_absolute_miss_difference (candidate_misses - reference_misses, reference = LRU unless stated otherwise)
wins_ties_losses (candidate strictly lower / equal / strictly higher miss_ratio than reference, per instance)

inferential_test.test: Wilcoxon signed-rank test on paired per-instance miss_ratio differences (candidate vs. reference), two-sided
inferential_test.rationale: 21 paired, non-independent-request instances; a paired non-parametric test avoids assuming normality of miss-ratio differences across heterogeneous trace families and does not require an independence-of-requests assumption the data does not satisfy
inferential_test.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm-Bonferroni across the set of pairwise policy comparisons reported in a single table (family-wise error rate control)
inferential_test.effect_size: matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation, reported alongside the p-value
inferential_test.confidence_intervals: bootstrap (10,000 resamples over the 21 paired instances) 95% CI on the mean miss-ratio difference

explicit_prohibitions: Do not treat the 40,000 scored requests within one (trace, capacity) instance as independent replicates for any test.
Do not select which policies/instances to report after viewing results.
Do not change the test, correction, or threshold after viewing evict_value_v1_fair_v1's results on the canonical traces.
Do not compute statistics over deployment_full_stream and primary_controlled_window rows together -- report each variant's statistics separately, never pooled.
